title: Aureline M5 live-target handoff
description: Canonical per-domain live-target handoff for an archived runbook execution packet or a review / incident snapshot. Names the object class, its supported-line association, the live-target availability, whether an explicit open-live-target action is offered, and the target identity, trust, route, and authority that action validates before reopening a current object — or the metadata-only exit taken when no live target remains — so an archived packet or review snapshot is never silently reopened as if it were live. Downstream shell, runbook-archive, review / incident, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's handoff by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
